title: RBI Draft Directions on Call, Notice & Term Money Markets: SPD Limit Raised to 400%
summary: Allows AIFIs and NBFCs into term money market; caps NBFC term money borrowing at 200% NOF.

blocks.content: Allows AIFIs and NBFCs into term money market; caps NBFC term money borrowing at 200% NOF.

items: Entity Expansion: AIFIs and NBFCs (excl Base Layer) permitted to borrow and lend in term money market; corporate entities as lenders.
Borrowing Caps: Standalone Primary Dealers (SPDs) term money limit raised to 400% of Net Owned Funds (NOF); NBFC limit set at 200% NOF.
Platform Mandate: All participants must join NDS-CALL platform within 6 months; OTC deals reported within 15 mins.

blocks.summary: Call Money (1 day), Notice Money (2-14 days), Term Money (15 days - 1 year).

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: SPD term money limit (400% NOF) vs NBFC term money limit (200% NOF) vs SPD call/notice limit (225%).
